config.label: Google Gemini API key
config.description: Google Gemini API key. Enables the Gemini provider. At least one provider key is required.

config.label: OpenAI API key
config.description: OpenAI API key. Enables the OpenAI provider. At least one provider key is required.

config.label: Provider used when a tool call does not name one: gemini or openai
config.description: Provider used when a tool call does not name one: gemini or openai. Defaults to whichever key is set, preferring gemini.

config.label: Default Gemini model
config.description: Default Gemini model. Defaults to gemini-3.1-flash-image.

config.label: Default OpenAI model
config.description: Default OpenAI model. Defaults to gpt-image-2.

config.label: Directory used when a tool call passes no output_path
config.description: Directory used when a tool call passes no output_path.

config.label: Comma separated directories that file reads and writes are confined to
config.description: Comma separated directories that file reads and writes are confined to. Unset means unrestricted.

config.label: Per-request timeout to the provider API in milliseconds
config.description: Per-request timeout to the provider API in milliseconds. Defaults to 180000.

config.label: Path of the JSONL image ledger
config.description: Path of the JSONL image ledger. Defaults to ~/.image-gen-mcp/images.jsonl. Set to none to disable the file.
